title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10906)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10906) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10906). This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 1754 : 1986 'Photography — Cameras using 35 mm and 16 mm film — Picture sizes', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the the Photographic Equipment Sectional Committee ( LMD 24) and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The original version of this standard, 'Picture sizes in photographic cameras using films 35 mm and smaller' was based on ISO 1754 : 1974 'Photography — Cameras using films 35 mm and smaller — Picture sizes', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). Hormonization of the standard with International Standard has been made by the adoption of ISO 1754 : 1986. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
